title: Camelot 3000 #10 of 12 DC Comics March 1984 Brian Bolland Cover Mike W. Barr
condition_description: Cover wear and a small chipped area at the top left corner by the DC logo; some spine and edge wear. Interior complete. See photos.
description:
Camelot 3000 #10 of 12 (March 1984), DC Comics maxi-series on Baxter paper. Written by Mike W. Barr, art and cover by Brian Bolland - King Arthur and the Knights of the Round Table return in the year 3000. $1.25 cover price.

Back cover: Masters of the Universe The Power of He-Man Mattel Electronics video game ad.

Condition: worn, with a small chipped area at the top left corner of the cover by the DC logo. See photos.

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
